summary: Responsive section combining large images or videos with content in flexible proportions.
features: Image or video media support with responsive sizing
Separate section and box background color customization
shortDescription: The Image and Content section creates visually engaging layouts by pairing large media with text or other content blocks. Media can be single images or videos with responsive sizing options for different breakpoints. The section offers three proportion ratios (50/50, 60/40, 70/30) with content positioned left or right of the media. Both the outer section and inner content box have independent background color controls. When added, placeholder content helps users visualize the layout before adding real assets.
